qs.en: make a phone call

qs.en: Your clothes are very pretty.

qs.audio: 他们在工作。
qs.en: They are working.

qs.audio: 我朋友是老师。
qs.en: My friend is a teacher.

qs.audio: 李小姐，请坐。
qs.en: Miss Li, please sit down.

title: Listening 3 · Dialogues
instr: Listen to the short dialogue. Choose the picture it is about.

qs.audio: 这个椅子多少钱？ 七十块。
qs.zh: 男：这个椅子多少钱？ 女：七十块。
qs.py: zhège yǐzi duōshao qián? qīshí kuài.
qs.en: How much is this chair? 70 yuan.

qs.audio: 他会开车吗？ 会。他开车三年多了。
qs.zh: 女：他会开车吗？ 男：会。他开车三年多了。
qs.py: tā huì kāi chē ma? huì. tā kāi chē sān nián duō le.
qs.en: Can he drive? Yes, he has driven for over three years.

qs.audio: 你去哪儿了？ 我去买了些东西。
qs.zh: 男：你去哪儿了？ 女：我去买了些东西。
qs.py: nǐ qù nǎr le? wǒ qù mǎi le xiē dōngxi.
qs.en: Where did you go? I went to buy some things.

qs.audio: 今天我请你吃饭。 太好了，我想吃中国菜。
qs.zh: 女：今天我请你吃饭。 男：太好了，我想吃中国菜。
qs.py: jīntiān wǒ qǐng nǐ chī fàn. tài hǎo le, wǒ xiǎng chī Zhōngguó cài.
qs.en: I'm treating you to a meal today. Great, I want Chinese food.

qs.audio: 他们是谁？ 他们三个都是我的学生。
qs.zh: 男：他们是谁？ 女：他们三个都是我的学生。
qs.py: tāmen shì shéi? tāmen sān ge dōu shì wǒ de xuésheng.
qs.en: Who are they? All three are my students.

title: Listening 4 · Question and choice
instr: Listen to the passage and the question. Choose the answer.

qs.audio: 明天是二月二十五日，星期三。 问：明天是星期几？
qs.zh: 明天是二月二十五日，星期三。问：明天是星期几？
qs.py: míngtiān shì èr yuè èrshíwǔ rì, xīngqīsān. wèn: míngtiān shì xīngqī jǐ?
qs.en: Tomorrow is Feb 25, Wednesday. Q: What day is tomorrow?

qs.audio: 我会说汉语，我能写一些汉字。 问：他会什么？
qs.zh: 我会说汉语，我能写一些汉字。问：他会什么？
qs.py: wǒ huì shuō Hànyǔ, wǒ néng xiě yìxiē Hànzì. wèn: tā huì shénme?
qs.en: I can speak Chinese and write some characters. Q: What can he do?

qs.audio: 下个月，我和王老师去北京。 问：他和谁去北京？
qs.zh: 下个月，我和王老师去北京。问：他和谁去北京？
qs.py: xià ge yuè, wǒ hé Wáng lǎoshī qù Běijīng. wèn: tā hé shéi qù Běijīng?
qs.en: Next month I'm going to Beijing with Teacher Wang. Q: Who is he going with?

qs.audio: 我有一个女儿，今年四岁了。 问：女儿几岁了？
qs.zh: 我有一个女儿，今年四岁了。问：女儿几岁了？
qs.py: wǒ yǒu yí ge nǚ'ér, jīnnián sì suì le. wèn: nǚ'ér jǐ suì le?
qs.en: I have a daughter, four this year. Q: How old is she?

qs.audio: 昨天下雨了，很冷。 问：昨天天气怎么样？
qs.zh: 昨天下雨了，很冷。问：昨天天气怎么样？
qs.py: zuótiān xià yǔ le, hěn lěng. wèn: zuótiān tiānqì zěnmeyàng?
qs.en: It rained yesterday and was cold. Q: How was the weather?

title: Reading 4 · Fill the gap
instr: Choose the word that fits the gap.

qs.en: She studies at school in the morning.

qs.py: wǒ qī diǎn sānshí fēn qù ( ), shí diǎn qián huílai.
qs.en: I go to the train station at 7:30, back before 10.
Hello, is Mr. Zhang at home?

qs.zh: 女：（　　），我今天不能和你去看医生了。 男：没关系。
qs.py: ( ), wǒ jīntiān bù néng hé nǐ qù kàn yīshēng le. méi guānxi.
qs.en: Sorry, I can't go to the doctor with you today. It's okay.

qs.zh: 男：你（　　）爸爸的衣服了吗？ 女：在桌子后面。
qs.py: nǐ ( ) bàba de yīfu le ma? zài zhuōzi hòumian.
qs.en: Did you see dad's clothes? Behind the table.
